ACCESS: Prisma `server` id `cmsecmdps0001hlp27ai6mr7c`; `decryptSecret(rootPasswordEnc)`; ssh2 root; ASSERT ip==51.79.226.215. The repo is at `/opt/nexis` (git, remote `git@github.com:santino1233/studionexis.git`; push via `GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o IdentitiesOnly=yes'`; deploy key has write access). Board cards via Prisma (nxeon DB). tsx scripts under /opt/nxeon/scripts/, run, delete.

FIX 1 — Uploads path bug (real latent defect): the media routes hardcode `ROOT = "/opt/nexis/uploads"`, so when the STAGING app writes an uploaded photo it lands in PROD's uploads dir (cross-environment pollution). Find the media/upload route handlers (grep for `/opt/nexis/uploads` or a ROOT const in the upload/media code), and make the uploads root **environment-aware** (e.g. driven by an env var like `UPLOADS_DIR` with a sane default, or derived from the app's own working dir / a config) so staging writes to its own dir and prod to its own. Don't break prod's path (prod must keep using its existing dir); just stop staging from writing into it. 

FIX 2 — Booking page domain never activates: `publicSiteUrl()` switches to the custom domain the instant it's set, but `policies.domain.status` is only ever set to `PENDING_DNS` — nothing ever promotes it to `ACTIVE`. The prior investigation noted this touches a ~9-caller helper and needs the verification lifecycle wired. Implement it carefully: add the missing transition so a domain that passes DNS verification is set to `ACTIVE`, and make `publicSiteUrl()` only use the custom domain when status is `ACTIVE` (so an unverified domain doesn't hijack the public URL). If wiring the full verification lifecycle is too large/risky to do safely, implement the smaller safe piece (gate `publicSiteUrl()` on `ACTIVE`) and write the rest as a plan on the card.

FOR BOTH: work on a branch `fix/uploads-path-and-booking-domain` off origin/main in a clean checkout — BUT since `/opt/nexis` is prod's working tree, do your edits in **`/opt/nexis-staging`** (the staging deploy) and build/restart `nexis-staging` there; then separately commit the same source changes to the branch in `/opt/nexis` (git add only the changed source files, commit, push the branch — do NOT push main, do NOT rebuild/restart nexis-next). Verify staging builds + `nexis-staging` restarts healthy + `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3106/` is 200-ish.

BOARD (board name contains "Nexis"): move **"Photos Bug"** and **"Booking page domain"** from Ideas to **Review** (or In progress→Review), each with a comment: what you changed, staging status, the branch name, and what's needed to ship to prod. If FIX 2 was only partially done, say exactly what remains.

CONSTRAINTS: staging only; never touch prod `nexis-next`/live site, the kaymo site, the .200 box, /opt/nxeon, or push to main. If a classifier blocks a command, report verbatim + stop.

Return: both fixes (files changed, approach), staging build/health, the pushed branch, and the two card states.
